not_claimed: what the object, its counted collection, its range collection, the elements, trees, nodes, or strings denote
caller semantics beyond the recorded site addresses and caller FDE ranges
behavior on a null counted base with a nonzero count, on a null range begin with a nonzero range, or on cyclic or dangling trees (the model raises on these instead)

counted_drain.element_address: base + (count - 1) * 0x3f0 after decrementing the stored count
counted_drain.order: reverse: element count-1 first, down to element 0
counted_drain.stores: the decremented count back to obj+0x00 before each element is destroyed

range_destroy.begin: qword at obj+0x1f90, read once at phase entry
range_destroy.end: qword at obj+0x1f98, read once at phase entry
range_destroy.order: forward: begin, begin + 0x3f0, and so on until the cursor equals end

tail.storage_freed: no: the range storage itself is never deleted, and the object itself is never deleted
tail.store: begin into obj+0x1f98 (end = begin) once the range is fully destroyed

references.element_layout: open PR #2421 (0x5d5e5d0, same per-element field layout and order)
references.sibling_routine: open PR #2423 (0x5d5e220 vector destructor, called by the same eight caller functions at adjacent sites; this routine is disjoint from it and frees no storage)

routine.kind: two-collection element destroy: counted-array drain, then range destroy

string_rule.inline_when: stored pointer equals the address of its own capacity/inline slot (+X+0x10)
string_rule.layout: pointer at +X, size at +X+0x08, capacity-or-inline at +X+0x10

tree_walk.per_node: teardown(child list at node+0x18) via 0x5d4cfd0, dispose string B (+0x40), dispose string A (+0x20), delete node with size 0x60, advance to +0x10 successor loaded before the deletes
